name: Taiwan

unverified.exam_name: The Nationality Act refers to standards for "recognition, testing, exemption, fee charging"; the standards themselves would not load.
unverified.format: Set by the standards, which were not read.
unverified.fee: The Act says fees are charged; the amount is in the standards.
unverified.exemptions: The Act says the standards provide for exemption; not read.

notes: Nationality Act art. 3: the applicant must have "basic proficiency in the national language" and "basic knowledge of the rights and obligations of R.O.C. nationals", under standards covering recognition, testing and exemption. Taiwan is not a UN member; it is included because it runs its own naturalization.
